name: BBQ
intro: BBQ（Bias Benchmark for Question Answering）是技术报告中反复引用的问答偏见评测，用于检查模型在不同社会属性语境下是否产生偏见回答。
build_method: 有出处的偏见模板手写, 四条件扩展, 五人一致性验证
build_method_en: Sourced bias-template writing, four-condition expansion, five-rater agreement validation
intro_en: BBQ, the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering, is repeatedly cited in the technical reports as a QA bias benchmark for checking whether models produce biased answers across social contexts.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[Sourced harmful-bias evidence] --> B[Write 9 categories plus 2 intersectional categories; at least 25 templates each]
    B --> C[Expand ambiguous and disambiguated contexts with negative and non-negative questions]
    C --> D[Balance target order and choose 1 of 10 UNKNOWN phrases]
    D --> E[Sample one question from each of four conditions; five raters each]
    E --> F{All four reach at least 4 of 5}
    F -- no --> G[Revise template and regenerate all four conditions]
    G --> C
    F -- yes --> H[Release 58,492 questions]
    H --> I[Compute accuracy, sDIS, and sAMB]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A[Sourced harmful-bias evidence] --> B[Write templates for 9 bias and 2 intersectional categories; at least 25 per category]
    B --> C[Create four conditions: ambiguous or disambiguated by negative or non-negative question]
    C --> D[Expand slots, balance target order, and select one of 10 UNKNOWN phrases]
    D --> E[Sample one item per condition and collect five judgments per item]
    E --> F{Do all four items reach 4 of 5 agreement}
    F -- fail --> G[Revise the template, regenerate, and revalidate all four items]
    G --> C
    F -- pass --> H[Release 58,492 three-choice questions]
    H --> I[Evaluate accuracy plus sDIS and sAMB]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A[有出处的有害偏见资料] --> B[为 9 类偏见与 2 类交叉偏见手写模板；每类至少 25 个]
    B --> C[生成模糊或消歧情境与负向或非负向问题的四种条件]
    C --> D[扩展槽位、平衡目标顺序并选用 10 种 UNKNOWN 表达之一]
    D --> E[每种条件抽一题且每题由五人判断]
    E --> F{四道题是否都达到 4/5}
    F -- 失败 --> G[修改模板并重新生成、重验全部四题]
    G --> C
    F -- 通过 --> H[发布 58,492 道三选一问题]
    H --> I[计算准确率、sDIS 与 sAMB]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2110.08193v2 §3.1, §3.2, §3.3, §4, Figure 1, §5, and Appendix D. Authors write sourced templates for nine bias categories plus two intersectional categories, with at least 25 templates per category. Each template expands into ambiguous/disambiguated context crossed with negative/non-negative questions, balanced answer order, and one of ten equivalent UNKNOWN phrases. Validation samples one question from each of the four conditions and assigns five people to each; every question must reach at least 4/5 agreement. Failure revises the template and repeats all four checks before the final 58,492-item release. Evaluation reports accuracy, sDIS, and ambiguity-adjusted sAMB.
